body.title: Verify complete removal and compatibility with self-check evidence
body.summary: Run focused production-registration, no-side-effect, human approval/completion, historical read and unrelated service checks; clean production build and inspect packaged output for stale runtime files; verify both current IDE clients surface errors without polling. Record self-check evidence and limitations without invoking broken automated reviews or deploying/restarting the daemon.
acceptanceChecks: Endpoint/schema inventory and exact error contracts pass across accepted phases and unary/stream/MCP dispatch; repeated failures allocate no review state/connections.
Missing/failed BUILD, stale/incomplete task set, integrity/team/signoff/upstream refusal checks remain effective; valid human-approved work completes without CR.
Clean build removes planted stale review output; package/import inspection finds no deleted runtime; historical fixtures/hashes and both current IDE client error contracts pass.
Self-review evidence records actual commands/results and limitations; no installed-daemon update, restart or automated-review certification is claimed.

tests.name: Clean production build and package contain no deleted review implementation or planted stale review output
End-to-end unavailable review calls preserve historical data and do not start client polling or unrelated service regressions
